name: Code Maxer
description: Picks the right specialist skills from a bank of coding skills, then does the coding task with them.
why: One entry point to a **bank of development skills**: the agent spots the stack and the phase (design, fix, tests, review), loads **the smallest useful set** of specialists, and gets the work done. Works on top of that skill bank, installed next to it.
yes: A coding task where you don't know which skill fits
Work spanning several layers, like front-end and API
Debugging, then fixing, in an unfamiliar stack
no: A one-line fix you already know how to make
Without the skill bank installed alongside

examples.title: Fixing a bug
examples.input:
Use `$code-maxer` to find why the
login form sometimes double-submits.
examples.output: The agent names the skills it picks (a debugging guide and the front-end specialist), traces the cause, fixes it, then says what it checked.

examples.title: A feature across the stack
examples.input:
Use `$code-maxer` to add CSV export
to the orders page and its API.
examples.output: One specialist per layer, the change on both sides, and the checks that were actually run.
